reuse.why: Uses the existing link helpers (link.assertAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank), server config, post and BankSyncError, as the other providers do.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount copies the ~60-line upgrade/insert/sync/notify body of the other provider link functions, and downloadFintegraTransactions is a near copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree puts it: handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config, type in types/models.

scope.why: Only server-side wiring for the new provider; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing pattern, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a fifth copy of the download function, so cross-provider fixes must be repeated again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the shared link helpers and syncAccount dispatch like the other providers.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are verbatim per-provider copies, not disguised.
